name: Reference: is there a market
goal: Find out whether small bakeries would pay for a shared ordering page. The finish line is a findings report with each bet confirmed, killed or inconclusive on evidence from outside this project. The reader is the chairman deciding whether to build it. Interest, sign-ups and compliments do not count; a bakery saying what it would pay does. If nothing can be confirmed, what is owed is what was tried and why each bet ended.
